how.title: How to reserve
how.step1: Open a card or a lot and add it to your selection.
how.step2: Send your request with your name and email address, without creating an account.
how.step3: The seller confirms availability, then agrees payment and shipping with you.
how.help: A request does not hold the cards: they are reserved once the seller accepts it.

signup.title: Create an account

signup.unique_password: Choose a password used only on this site: never reuse one from another site (Pokémon account, Google…).
signup.data_html: Your name, email address and requests are used only to handle your reservations. What is kept, for how long, and how to ask for deletion: your data.
